people.headline: Principal AI Advisor at Fellowmind | Copilot, Agents & AI Transformation | Microsoft MVP | Speaker
people.about:
As Principal AI Advisor at Fellowmind, I help organizations turn AI potential into measurable business value through Microsoft 365 Copilot, intelligent agents, and AI transformation initiatives.

With more than 30 years of experience in enterprise IT, I combine strategic business thinking with hands-on technology expertise. My passion is helping organizations move from AI experimentation to practical adoption and new ways of working where people and AI achieve better outcomes together.

I advise leaders and organizations on:
• AI strategy and transformation
• Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio
• Agents and agentic AI solutions
• Microsoft Foundry
• Governance, adoption, and change management
• Building AI-enabled organizations

Beyond customer engagements, I am an international speaker, blogger, community leader, and event organizer. I write at Future Work and organize the AI-Native Workplace Summit, Microsoft AI User Group Finland, and Microsoft 365 Copilot User Group Finland.

Technology alone does not create transformation. People do. AI simply changes what becomes possible.

Let's connect if you're exploring how to turn AI potential into business value, adopt Copilot and agents, build AI-ready organizations, or navigate your AI transformation journey.

Turning AI into business value.
Curiosity required. AI enabled. 🤠

people.name: Joël
people.about:
I want to understand why something works the way it does. That goes for technology, but just as much for people, habits and choices. Handy in my line of work, less handy at birthday parties. As a Senior Modern workplace & Security Consultant at Yellow Arrow I design and build modern workplaces across multiple client tenants. The term says little, I know, so in practice: identity, devices and access. 
My home turf is Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Conditional Access and PIM. Security isn’t a separate chapter. 
My motto: security that fits, not security that fights. It shapes the design from day one.

The best part is laying a solid foundation, because that’s where room appears. Room for real attention to a customer, for trying new things, for work you look back on with a good feeling. I share what I learn in Microsoft 365 communities, at events, on LinkedIn and on intothecloud.eu.

Outside work: the gym, running shoes, the barbecue, family. I think better when the rest is in order.

people.name: Mirko Peters
people.headline: Microsoft MVP
people.about:
Mirko Peters ist Microsoft MVP, Podcaster, Autor und Konferenzveranstalter mit Schwerpunkt auf Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, Azure, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric und KI-Agenten. Er hostet den Podcast M365.FM und die m365 Show auf YouTube mit animierten Erklärvideos (Sticky Man Explained) und Zertifizierungskursen, organisiert die kostenlose Online-Konferenz M365Con (11.–22. Januar 2027) und veröffentlicht E-Books zu Microsoft-Themen. Seine Inhalte richten sich an IT-Admins, Architekten, Entwickler und Entscheider, die die Microsoft-Cloud ohne Marketing-Rauschen verstehen wollen. Die Podcast-Episoden gibt es als KI-vertontes Audio in 19 Sprachen.

Mirko Peters is a Microsoft MVP, podcaster, author and conference organizer focused on Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, Azure, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric and AI agents. He hosts the podcast M365.FM and the m365 Show on YouTube with animated explainers (Sticky Man Explained) and certification courses, organizes the free online conference M365Con (11-22 January 2027) and publishes e-books on Microsoft topics. His content is aimed at IT admins, architects, developers and decision makers who want to understand the Microsoft cloud without marketing noise. The podcast episodes are available as AI-dubbed audio in 19 languages.

de.headline: Microsoft MVP | Power Automate und Copilot Studio für KMU in der Schweiz | Gründer KMUpower
de.about:
Ich helfe kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen in der Schweiz, ihre Abläufe mit der Power Platform zu automatisieren. Mit dem, was in Microsoft 365 schon da ist: Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Power Automate und Copilot Studio.

Seit 2023 führe ich KMUpower. Ich baue Lösungen für Kunden oder zeige ihren Teams live, wie es geht. In der Power Platform Academy unterrichte ich Citizen Developer, und jeden Freitag gibt es einen kostenlosen Live-Workshop von 30 bis 45 Minuten zu einem konkreten Thema. Auf PowerPlatformTip teile ich kurze Tipps aus der Praxis.

Mein Schwerpunkt: kleine Helfer, die sofort Zeit sparen, saubere Governance ohne Overkill und KI dort, wo sie sich wirklich lohnt.

en.headline: Microsoft MVP | Power Automate & Copilot Studio for SMBs in Switzerland | Founder of KMUpower
en.about:
I help small and mid-sized companies in Switzerland automate their processes with the Power Platform, using what they already have in Microsoft 365: Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Power Automate and Copilot Studio.

I founded KMUpower in 2023. I build solutions for clients or show their teams live how to do it. In the Power Platform Academy I teach citizen developers, and every Friday there is a free live workshop of 30 to 45 minutes on one concrete topic. On PowerPlatformTip I share short tips from real projects.

My focus: small helpers that save time right away, clean governance without overkill, and AI where it actually pays off.

de.headline: Microsoft MVP | Team Lead Jumpstart, Copilot & Agents bei Witivio
de.about: Schweizer Berater aus Lausanne und Microsoft MVP für Microsoft 365 Copilot und Copilot Studio. Ich leite das Jumpstart-Team bei Witivio, einem Microsoft Partner, und unterstütze Organisationen dabei, Copilot- und Agenten-Pilotprojekte in den produktiven Einsatz zu bringen. Mein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Agentenentwicklung mit Copilot Studio, Power-Platform-Architektur und Governance. Ich arbeite auf Deutsch, Englisch und Französisch. Ich spreche regelmässig in der Microsoft-Community, unter anderem mit «Stop Reading Dashboards» im Microsoft 365 & Power Platform Community Call. Ausserdem entwickle ich MCP-Server für die Power Platform, etwa zum Debuggen von Power-Automate-Flows, und veröffentliche Agentic Weekly, einen wöchentlichen Überblick über Neuigkeiten zu Microsoft-KI.

fr.headline: Microsoft MVP | Team Lead Jumpstart, Copilot et agents chez Witivio
fr.about: Consultant suisse basé à Lausanne et Microsoft MVP pour Microsoft 365 Copilot et Copilot Studio. Je dirige l'équipe Jumpstart chez Witivio, partenaire Microsoft, et j'aide les organisations à passer des pilotes Copilot et agents à un usage réel en production. Mon travail couvre la conception d'agents avec Copilot Studio, l'architecture Power Platform et la gouvernance. Je travaille en français, en anglais et en allemand. J'interviens régulièrement dans la communauté Microsoft, notamment avec « Stop Reading Dashboards » lors du Microsoft 365 & Power Platform Community Call. Je développe aussi des serveurs MCP pour Power Platform, par exemple pour déboguer les flux Power Automate, et je publie Agentic Weekly, une revue hebdomadaire de l'actualité de l'IA chez Microsoft.
